summary.short: Ley 21.663, dated 26 March 2024, sets cybersecurity duties for State bodies and for private institutions that provide essential services, and creates the National Cybersecurity Agency (ANCI) with supervisory and sanction powers.
summary.long: Ley 21.663, the Cybersecurity Framework Law dated 26 March 2024, sets institutional rules and cybersecurity duties for State bodies and for private institutions providing essential services. Essential services and vital-importance operators are designated by resolution of the ANCI. Vital operators must maintain a continuous information security management system and certified continuity and cybersecurity plans. All covered institutions must report significant incidents to the national CSIRT: an early alert within three hours, an update within 72 hours (24 hours where a vital operator's services are affected), and a final report within 15 days. The Agency issues binding protocols and standards, supervises compliance, and may order particular audits, inspections and system access, with contested access requiring judicial authorisation. The law also creates a multisectoral council, a defence CSIRT, a secure state network and an interministerial committee. Infringements are minor, serious or very serious, with fines of up to 5,000 to 40,000 UTM depending on tier and vital-operator status; Penal Code sanctions apply to confidentiality breaches. Good-faith vulnerability research is exempted from criminal liability under registration and notification conditions. Sectoral authorities may issue equivalent rules that prevail. Transitional provisions let the President set the Agency's start date by decree within one year of publication.

Activo informático: toda información almacenada en una red y sistema informático que tenga valor para una persona u organización.
Agencia: la Agencia Nacional de Ciberseguridad, que se conocerá en forma abreviada como ANCI.
Ciberataque: intento de destruir, exponer, alterar, deshabilitar, o exfiltrar u obtener acceso o hacer uso no autorizado de un activo informático.
Ciberseguridad: preservación de la confidencialidad e integridad de la información y de la disponibilidad y resiliencia de las redes y sistemas informáticos

definitions.term: CSIRT (Equipo de Respuesta a Incidentes de Seguridad Informática)

evidence.quote: Equipo de Respuesta a Incidentes de Seguridad Informática o CSIRT: centros multidisciplinarios que tienen por objeto prevenir, detectar, gestionar y responder a incidentes de ciberseguridad o ciberataques
Incidente de ciberseguridad: todo evento que perjudique o comprometa la confidencialidad o integridad de la información
Red y sistema informático: conjunto de dispositivos, cables, enlaces, enrutadores u otros equipos de comunicaciones o sistemas que almacenen, procesen o transmitan datos digitales.
Riesgo: posibilidad de ocurrencia de un incidente de ciberseguridad
Vulnerabilidad: debilidad de un activo o control que puede ser explotado por una o más amenazas informáticas.

a los prestadores de servicios esenciales que sean calificados como operadores de importancia vital
Se considerará que un incidente de ciberseguridad tiene efecto significativo si es capaz de interrumpir la continuidad de un servicio esencial

definitions.defined_in: Ley N° 20.416 (referenced; not reproduced in this document)

evidence.quote: tal como se definen en la ley N° 20.416

obligations.summary: The Agency and the sectoral authorities must perform their functions in coordination, pursue unity of action and avoid duplication or interference of functions.

evidence.quote: la Agencia y las autoridades sectoriales deberán cumplir sus cometidos coordinadamente

obligations.summary: The Agency establishes by resolution of the Director the providers of essential services that are qualified as operators of vital importance (OIV); it must take into account the size of private institutions, including MSMEs.

evidence.quote: La Agencia establecerá mediante resolución dictada por el Director o la Directora Nacional

obligations.summary: At least every three years the Agency must review and update the qualification of operators of vital importance; it requests reports from sectoral public bodies and sets a preliminary and final list after consultation.

evidence.quote: Al menos cada tres años, la Agencia deberá revisar y actualizar la calificación de operadores de importancia vital

obligations.summary: A regulation of the Ministry in charge of public security shall govern the remaining aspects of the OIV qualification procedure.

evidence.quote: Un reglamento expedido por el Ministerio encargado de la seguridad pública contemplará los demás aspectos del procedimiento

obligations.summary: Obligated institutions must permanently apply technological, organizational, physical or informational measures to prevent, report and resolve cybersecurity incidents, and implement the protocols and standards set by the Agency and sectoral standards.

evidence.quote: deberán aplicar de manera permanente las medidas para prevenir, reportar y resolver incidentes de ciberseguridad

obligations.summary: The Agency must observe Art. 25 and hold public consultation on security protocols and standards, publishing them with a justification report; it must set differentiated security measures by type of organization, considering SMEs.

evidence.quote: La Agencia deberá establecer medidas de seguridad diferenciadas según el tipo de organización de que se trate

obligations.summary: All OIV must implement a continuous information security management system to determine risks and to assess both probability and potential impact of incidents.

evidence.quote: Implementar un sistema de gestión de seguridad de la información continuo

obligations.summary: OIV must keep a record of the actions executed under their information security management system, as set by regulation.

evidence.quote: Mantener un registro de las acciones ejecutadas que compongan el sistema de gestión de seguridad de la información

obligations.summary: OIV must prepare and implement operational continuity and cybersecurity plans, certified under Art. 28 and reviewed at least every two years; they must also adopt timely measures to reduce the impact and spread of an incident, including restricting access to systems.

evidence.quote: Elaborar e implementar planes de continuidad operacional y ciberseguridad

obligations.summary: OIV must continuously carry out reviews, exercises, drills and analyses of networks and systems to detect threats, and communicate the results to the national CSIRT.

evidence.quote: Realizar continuamente operaciones de revisión, ejercicios, simulacros y análisis de las redes, sistemas informáticos

obligations.summary: OIV must hold the certifications required by the law (Art. 28).

evidence.quote: Contar con las certificaciones que señala el artículo 28.

obligations.summary: OIV must inform potentially affected persons, where they can be identified and when the Agency requires it, of incidents that may seriously compromise their information or systems, especially involving personal data.
obligations.conditional_on: When the Agency requires it, or when necessary to prevent or manage an incident

evidence.quote: Informar a los potenciales afectados, en la medida que puedan identificarse

obligations.summary: OIV must maintain cybersecurity training, education and continuing hygiene programs for workers and collaborators, and must designate a cybersecurity delegate who acts as counterpart of the Agency.

evidence.quote: Contar con programas de capacitación, formación y educación continua de sus trabajadores y colaboradores

obligations.summary: Public and private institutions under Art. 4 must report to the national CSIRT significant cyberattacks and incidents: an early alert within 3 hours; an update within 72 hours (24 hours for OIV whose essential services are affected); a final report within 15 calendar days; continued reporting if the incident persists; OIV must also report their action plan within 7 days.
obligations.conditional_on: Incidents with significant effects under Art. 27

evidence.quote: tendrán la obligación de reportar al CSIRT Nacional los ciberataques e incidentes de ciberseguridad

obligations.summary: In State bodies, heads of service must require IT service providers to share information on vulnerabilities and incidents affecting State networks and systems.

evidence.quote: los jefes de servicio deberán exigir a los proveedores de servicios de tecnologías de la información que compartan la información sobre vulnerabilidades

obligations.summary: Service contracts with State bodies may not contain any clause that restricts or hinders the provider from communicating threat information, provided security and data protection are not compromised.

evidence.quote: los contratos de prestación de servicios no podrán contener ninguna cláusula que pueda restringir o dificultar de cualquier modo la comunicación de información sobre amenazas

obligations.summary: The Agency must issue the instructions needed for the proper making and reception of incident reports, and organize a single window for simultaneous notifications where more than one authority must be notified.

evidence.quote: La Agencia dictará las instrucciones que sean necesarias para la debida realización y recepción de los reportes

obligations.summary: A regulation of the Ministry in charge of public security shall regulate the content of the different reports under Art. 9.

evidence.quote: Un reglamento expedido por el Ministerio encargado de la seguridad pública regulará el contenido de las diversas clases de reportes

obligations.summary: In exercising its functions the Agency must always ensure regulatory coherence, so that its actions fit harmoniously in the national regulatory and sanctioning framework.

evidence.quote: la Agencia deberá siempre velar por la coherencia normativa

obligations.summary: The Agency issues the protocols and standards under Art. 7 and general and particular instructions that are mandatory for public and private institutions obligated by the law, as well as other rules needed for application.

evidence.quote: las instrucciones generales y particulares, de carácter obligatorio, para las instituciones, tanto públicas como privadas obligadas por la presente ley

obligations.summary: The Agency must create and administer a National Registry of Cybersecurity Incidents; it also qualifies essential services and OIV, certifies compliance by State bodies, and must coordinate a national cybersecurity capability exercise each October.

evidence.quote: Crear y administrar un Registro Nacional de Incidentes de Ciberseguridad.

obligations.summary: Obligated entities whose services were affected by an incident must provide potentially affected persons with truthful, sufficient and timely information, when the Agency so requires.
obligations.conditional_on: When required by the Agency under Art. 8(g)

evidence.quote: que entreguen a los potenciales afectados información veraz, suficiente y oportuna sobre su ocurrencia

obligations.summary: The supervised entity must cooperate at all times with Agency officials or authorized third parties during inspections and supervision.
obligations.conditional_on: Agency inspection, audit or analysis of the supervised entity

evidence.quote: La entidad fiscalizada deberá cooperar en todo momento con los funcionarios de la Agencia

obligations.summary: Once notified of an Agency instruction for access to networks and systems in a significant incident, the required party must provide all necessary access facilities; a private institution may object, in which case judicial authorization is needed.
obligations.conditional_on: Notified instruction of the Agency's Director in cases of significant-impact incidents

evidence.quote: Una vez notificado, el requerido deberá proporcionar todas las facilidades de acceso que sean necesarias.

obligations.summary: The Director must issue by resolution the regulations that the law assigns to the Agency.

evidence.quote: Dictar, mediante resolución, la normativa que de acuerdo a esta ley corresponda dictar a la Agencia.

obligations.summary: A Ministry regulation shall determine the internal structure of the Agency, subject to the authorized staffing and maximum personnel.

evidence.quote: Un reglamento expedido por el Ministerio encargado de la seguridad pública determinará la estructura interna del Servicio

obligations.summary: Each year the Director must issue a resolution, endorsed by the Budget Directorate, setting the Agency's staffing structure and the maximum number of workers.

evidence.quote: Una resolución dictada por el Director o la Directora de la Agencia, visada por la Dirección de Presupuestos, establecerá en forma anual la estructura de la dotación

obligations.summary: Agency staff may not provide personal services to persons or entities subject to the Agency's supervision, or to their managers or employees.

evidence.quote: Prohíbese al personal de la Agencia prestar por sí o a través de otras personas naturales o jurídicas, servicios personales a personas o a entidades sometidas a la fiscalización de la Agencia

obligations.summary: The Agency must keep secret vulnerability notifications, their supporting material and the identity of the notifier; the notifier's identity may be disclosed only with express consent.

evidence.quote: La Agencia deberá mantener en secreto la notificación, sus antecedentes y la identidad de quien la realice.

obligations.summary: The Advisory Council on Cybersecurity must meet at least four times a year; the Agency must provide the technical and administrative support the Council needs.

evidence.quote: El Consejo sesionará, a lo menos, cuatro veces al año

obligations.summary: The State Secure Connectivity Network (RCSE) provides internet interconnection and connectivity services to State administration bodies.

evidence.quote: que proveerá servicios de interconexión y conectividad a internet a los organismos de la Administración del Estado

obligations.summary: A regulation of the Ministry in charge of public security, endorsed by the Finance Minister, shall regulate the operation of the RCSE and the special obligations of State bodies.

evidence.quote: Un reglamento expedido por el Ministerio encargado de la seguridad pública y visado por el Ministro de Hacienda regulará el funcionamiento de la RCSE

obligations.summary: The national CSIRT must respond to significant cyberattacks and incidents, coordinate State CSIRTs and the defence CSIRT, act as liaison with foreign CSIRTs, supervise national incidents, provide training, request anonymized information, and issue early alerts to the community.

evidence.quote: Responder ante ciberataques o incidentes de ciberseguridad, cuando éstos sean de efecto significativo.

obligations.summary: Before issuing general protocols, technical standards or instructions that affect another sectoral authority's competence, the Agency must send the relevant information to that authority and request a report.
obligations.conditional_on: Where the Agency's protocols or instructions affect another sectoral authority's area

evidence.quote: deberá previamente remitir la información relevante a dicha entidad y solicitar un informe

obligations.summary: The requested sectoral authority must issue its report within 30 calendar days; sectoral authorities issuing general acts with effects on the Agency's areas must send the relevant information to the Agency and request a report, and take into account prior Agency protocols.
obligations.conditional_on: Request from the Agency or sectoral general acts affecting Agency competence

evidence.quote: La autoridad sectorial requerida deberá evacuar su informe dentro del plazo de treinta días corridos

obligations.summary: Supervised institutions must comply with the sectoral authority's general norms and instructions on prevention of cybersecurity incidents when managing their risks; these prevail over Agency norms where equivalent, subject to a joint norm.
obligations.conditional_on: Sectoral norms or instructions issued by a sectoral authority

evidence.quote: Las instituciones supervisadas deberán cumplir obligatoriamente con estas normas e instrucciones en la gestión de sus riesgos

obligations.summary: The Agency and the relevant sectoral authority must first issue a joint general norm setting criteria for assessing the equivalence of effects between Agency and sectoral rules.

evidence.quote: la Agencia y la autoridad sectorial correspondiente deberán previamente dictar una norma conjunta de carácter general

obligations.summary: State CSIRTs must take the necessary steps to support restoration of an affected service, under the coordination of the national CSIRT.
obligations.conditional_on: Incidents with significant effects under Art. 27

evidence.quote: Los CSIRT que pertenezcan a los organismos de la Administración del Estado tendrán la obligación de tomar las providencias necesarias

obligations.summary: Incident reports must omit all personal data or information, as set out in Art. 2(f) of Law 19.628; IP addresses are not considered personal data for this purpose.

evidence.quote: Deberá omitirse en los reportes de incidentes de ciberseguridad todo dato o información personal

obligations.summary: The specific procedure for notifying an incident, its form, anonymity conditions, report taxonomy and periodicity are to be set by the regulation of the law.

evidence.quote: serán establecidos en el reglamento de la presente ley

obligations.summary: OIV must obtain the cybersecurity certifications required by the law and those the Agency determines by regulation, issued only by bodies in the Agency's registry of authorized certifiers.

evidence.quote: Los operadores de importancia vital deberán obtener las certificaciones de ciberseguridad que señala esta ley

obligations.summary: Certification bodies must meet the requirements set by regulation to join the Agency's registry of authorized certifiers and must continue to meet them to remain in it.
obligations.conditional_on: Registration in the Agency's registry of certifiers

evidence.quote: Para formar parte de este registro bastará acreditar el cumplimiento de los requisitos que establezca el reglamento

obligations.summary: The Defence CSIRT must establish minimum cybersecurity protocols and standards for prevention, detection, containment, recovery and response within the Armed Forces and the Joint General Staff, considering the Agency's guidelines.

evidence.quote: Establecer los protocolos y estándares mínimos de ciberseguridad

obligations.summary: The Ministry of National Defence shall determine by regulation the functions of the defence institutional CSIRTs, in line with defence cyber policy and the Agency's guidelines.

evidence.quote: Las funciones de los CSIRT Institucionales de la Defensa Nacional serán determinadas por la reglamentación que el Ministerio de Defensa Nacional dicte al efecto

obligations.summary: All national defence institutions must report significant cyberattacks and incidents to the Defence CSIRT.
obligations.conditional_on: Incidents that may have significant effects

evidence.quote: Todas las instituciones de la defensa nacional deberán reportar los ciberataques e incidentes de ciberseguridad que puedan tener efectos significativos al CSIRT de la Defensa Nacional.

obligations.summary: The Defence CSIRT must report to the Agency all incidents it identifies, unless doing so would endanger national security and defence, as set by regulation.
obligations.conditional_on: Where national security and defence are not put at risk

evidence.quote: El CSIRT de la Defensa Nacional reportará a la Agencia todos los incidentes identificados

obligations.summary: Agency and CSIRT officials, and staff of State bodies who learn of the protected information, must keep its existence and content secret, even after leaving their posts.

evidence.quote: estarán obligados a mantener el carácter secreto de su existencia y contenido

obligations.summary: The duty of secrecy also applies to persons who, without being officials, learn of requests for special information-gathering procedures and related court rulings.

evidence.quote: La obligación de guardar secreto regirá, además, para aquellos que, sin ser funcionarios o funcionarias de la Agencia

obligations.summary: The Agency must keep and protect the confidentiality of information it receives in performing its functions, and must respect fundamental rights, including privacy and personal data protection.

evidence.quote: La Agencia deberá mantener y cautelar la reserva de la información que llegue a conocer en el desempeño de sus funciones

obligations.summary: The head of each State body must ensure the body applies suitable and necessary measures to prevent, report and resolve cybersecurity incidents.

evidence.quote: El jefe superior del organismo de la Administración del Estado deberá velar por que el organismo respectivo aplique las medidas idóneas y necesarias

obligations.summary: State bodies must adopt the measures the Agency indicates to remedy or prevent the infringements it identifies.

evidence.quote: deberán adoptar las medidas tendientes a subsanar o prevenir las infracciones que indique la Agencia

obligations.summary: The Interministerial Committee on Cybersecurity must advise the President on the National Cybersecurity Policy and its implementation, propose legal changes where relevant, support the Agency and consider the Multisectoral Council's recommendations.

evidence.quote: En el ejercicio de sus funciones, el Comité deberá:

obligations.summary: The Committee has an Executive Secretariat located in the Agency that provides technical, administrative and content support; the Agency's Director convenes, directs and records the sessions and implements agreements.

evidence.quote: El Comité contará con una Secretaría Ejecutiva radicada en la Agencia, la que prestará el apoyo técnico, administrativo y de contenidos

obligations.summary: A regulation of the Ministry in charge of public security shall set the operating rules of the Committee.

evidence.quote: Un reglamento expedido por el Ministerio encargado de la seguridad pública fijará las normas de funcionamiento del Comité.

obligations.summary: The Senate, Chamber of Deputies, Judiciary, Comptroller General, Central Bank, Public Prosecutor, Electoral Service and National Television Council must adopt security measures for their networks and systems; their highest authorities may issue rules taking the Agency's recommendations into account.

evidence.quote: deberán adoptar las medidas de seguridad de sus redes y sistemas informáticos que sean pertinentes

obligations.summary: The autonomous constitutional bodies listed in Art. 53 must agree incident reporting mechanisms and coordination and cooperation arrangements for incident response.

evidence.quote: deberán convenir mecanismos de reporte de incidentes de ciberseguridad

obligations.summary: Amends Ley 20.424 (Ministry of Defence organic statute), Art. 25, adding a letter k): the Ministry must conduct the Defence CSIRT in coordination with the Undersecretariat of Defence.

evidence.quote: Conducir al Equipo de Respuesta a Incidentes de Seguridad Informática de la Defensa Nacional en coordinación con la Subsecretaría de Defensa.

obligations.summary: Amends Ley 21.459, Art. 2 (new final paragraph): access to a system whose owner is domiciled in Chile is not criminally sanctioned only if, among other conditions, the person is registered in the Agency's register and informed the Agency of the access beforehand.
obligations.conditional_on: Conditions for exemption from criminal sanction for security research access

evidence.provision: Art. 55(1) (inserting Ley 21.459, Art. 2 inciso final, no. 1)
evidence.quote: Que se encuentre inscrito en el registro que al efecto lleve la Agencia Nacional de Ciberseguridad.

obligations.summary: Amends Ley 21.459, Art. 2: the access and the security vulnerabilities detected must be reported to the system's owner and to the Agency as soon as the access is made.
obligations.conditional_on: Conditions for exemption from criminal sanction for security research access

evidence.provision: Art. 55(1) (inserting Ley 21.459, Art. 2 inciso final, no. 3)
evidence.quote: Que el acceso y las vulnerabilidades de seguridad detectadas hayan sido reportadas al responsable del sistema informático y a la Agencia, tan pronto se hubiere realizado.

obligations.summary: Amends Ley 21.459, Art. 2: the person must not have publicly disclosed the information on the potential vulnerability.
obligations.conditional_on: Conditions for exemption from criminal sanction for security research access

evidence.provision: Art. 55(1) (inserting Ley 21.459, Art. 2 inciso final, no. 5)
evidence.quote: Que no haya divulgado públicamente la información relativa a la potencial vulnerabilidad.

obligations.summary: The President may, within one year of publication in the Official Gazette, issue decrees with force of law to set the Agency's start of activities, staffing, budget and other transitional matters.
obligations.applies_from: Within one year of publication in the Diario Oficial

evidence.quote: Facúltase al Presidente de la República para que en el plazo de un año de publicada en el Diario Oficial la presente ley

obligations.summary: The Ministry of the Interior and Public Security must issue the regulations referred to in the law.
obligations.applies_from: 180 days after publication of the law

evidence.quote: Dentro del plazo de ciento ochenta días posteriores a la publicación de la ley, el Ministerio del Interior y Seguridad Pública deberá expedir los reglamentos señalados en esta ley.

enforcement.authority: Agencia Nacional de Ciberseguridad (ANCI) (Art. 37); the competent sectoral authority where it has sanctioning competence under Art. 37 and Art. 26
enforcement.triggered_by: Infringement of the obligations this law prescribes for obliged subjects (Arts. 38 and 39), classified as leves, graves or gravísimas
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Leves: up to 5.000 UTM, or up to 10.000 UTM for an operador de importancia vital. Graves: up to 10.000 UTM, or up to 20.000 UTM for an operador de importancia vital. Gravísimas: up to 20.000 UTM, or up to 40.000 UTM for an operador de importancia vital.
enforcement.penalty_formula: Maximum fixed by infringement degree and by whether the infringer is an operador de importancia vital (see max_penalty_text). Amount is set considering the degree of security measures adopted, probability of the incident, exposure to risk, gravity of effects including social or economic repercussions, reiteration within three years, and size and economic capacity of the infringer. Where the same facts can sanction under several laws, the most serious sanction applies; no two or more administrative sanctions may be applied for the same facts.

enforcement.triggered_by: Disclosure of information reserved for the Comité Interministerial sobre Ciberseguridad
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Sanctioned as the crime of violación de secretos under Código Penal arts. 246, 247 and 247 bis; this text states no amounts

evidence.quote: La revelación de la información será sancionada de conformidad al delito de violación de secretos contemplado en los artículos 246, 247 y 247 bis del Código Penal.

enforcement.authority: The respective authority, under the disciplinary procedure of Título V of Ley 18.834 (Estatuto Administrativo)
enforcement.triggered_by: Acts performed by Agency personnel in the exercise of their functions
enforcement.penalty_reference: Ley 18.834, Título V 'De la Responsabilidad Administrativa'
